text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The Keeneland Cup is coming up soon... 
Maybe I should start moving up now.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Alright!! Are you two ready?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie Suisan~~~☆ Let's get crazy 
hyped and do this, do this!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What about Ojo? How is it, how is it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ruby and the others... are they about to 
run now?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All good to go, then!! Well then, on your 
mark—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The start!! Oryaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (So fast! All three of them—!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, ahahaha! I'm. Not. 
Losinggggg--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not yet!! Uwooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Helios and Bamboo both have incredible 
explosive power... No, but still—!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Ruby...!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That closing burst. That sharpness. 
That... speed...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant, pant*...! Guuuhhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—She's amazing as always, huh. Between her 
last race and now... Ruby's getting into 
peak condition at an incredible rate.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~~~~!?!? Thaaat's our young 
mistress♡ Looove ya~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the tandem run. —Would you 
care for one more, if you wouldn't mind?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...You don't look satisfied at all, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Satisfied. ...What a foreign concept.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Until the Sprinters Stakes, I must 
dedicate myself to further training."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (......"Sprinters Stakes.")

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Zephyr is running, too. And... so is 
Ruby...)

The night before the Keeneland Cup. Just 
to be extra safe, I had reached out to her 
doctor, but—

The attending physician went out of their 
way to visit the training camp and gave 
K.S.Miracle a thorough examination.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: To put it simply—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
No abnormalities were found. She seems to 
have accumulated a bit of fatigue, but it 
is well within an acceptable range.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
...It has gotten quite late. Miracle, you 
should head to sleep. I will discuss the 
rest with the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Um, well then...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'll be heading out first. 
...Good night.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: ......Now then.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned earlier, there were no 
abnormalities found. However—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"You called out to me because something 
was on your mind. That is my 
understanding, but what about you?"

I hesitated for a moment on how to put it 
into words, but decided to confess 
everything honestly. About how things were 
after the Hakodate Sprint Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So you're saying it didn't look 
like she was simply sleeping."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
As far as this examination shows, there 
are no particular signs of impaired 
consciousness or other issues, but—
choice_data_list: Or am I just overthinking it, I wonder?
Or am I just overthinking it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't say that for certain. ...To be 
honest, it's hard to say either way."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I do not mean to use this as an 
excuse, but... there is still much left 
unexplained regarding the bodies of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
There may be ailments a doctor's eye 
cannot catch. ...That is why.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
As her dedicated trainer who is always by 
her side, your strength is essential too. 
It's an absolute necessity to support her.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"...Also, forgive me for overstepping, but 
I must say this— not as her attending 
physician, but as her childhood friend."

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
I felt a fleeting, dangerous look in their 
eyes. ...Just a subtle impression, though.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry this is all I can say. 
Please take care of her, Trainer."

"Precariousness"... That was precisely 
what I felt from the current KS Miracle as 
well.

"Or rather, perhaps it's more accurate to 
say that feeling only grew stronger."

That precariousness had been there all 
along—the feeling that she might run off 
anywhere and never return. The terror of a 
resolve that seemed to wear away at her 
very being.

I feel like it's growing larger with each 
passing day—
choice_data_list: ...Anyway, I need to pull myself together.
...Anyway, I need to keep it together.

text_block_list.text:
Whether it was determination or anxiety, I 
pulled the blanket over my head as my 
thoughts grew hazy. The sleepless night 
broke into dawn with terrifying swiftness—

The day of the Keeneland Cup had finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's still quite a bit of time before 
the race. Did we get ready a little too 
early?
choice_data_list: Ah, if you have some free time—

text_block_list.text:
Hoping she would eat it, I offered her the 
jelly I had prepared.

Since it's race day, keep the portion 
small. Even so, it should provide great 
energy. Just as I handed it over—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, K.S.Miracle's Trainer! Do you 
have a moment!?

"I've been summoned." Hurrying toward the 
room's exit, she left behind those words.
choice_data_list: Sorry, go ahead and eat without me!
Sorry, feel free to eat without me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......I am so sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely eat it later. Once 
everything... is over...
